title: Wandering Ga'al (miniquest)
start: Talk to TzHaar-Ga'al-Kot (after using a ring of visibility on a ring of stone) somewhere outside the TzHaar City.

items.t: The items listed below are not consumed during the miniquest.
Ring of visibility (Sliske's gift will not work)

rewards.t: Ability to read the mysterious bookcase in the Fight Cauldron.

steps.t: Use a ring of visibility on a ring of stone anywhere outside of the TzHaar City.
p: The wandering Ga'al near the bookshelf following the completion of the miniquest.

steps.t: Talk to TzHaar-Ga'al-Kot. [Chat: 3 Can you read the ancient TzHaar Language? › 1 Go. I'll meet you at the Fight Cauldron.]
